information_requirement_traceability.description: The unified digital representation of all sellable items, including descriptions, images, categories, and standardized pricing derived from the store partners' offerings.

business_requirements.name: BR-01: Maintain Data Consistency Across Heterogeneous Sources
business_requirements.business_requirement: The Platform Operator must ensure that product descriptions, categories, and pricing are standardized and consistent across all Store Partners to prevent customer confusion and ensure a unified browsing experience.
business_requirements.business_objective: To eliminate catalog inconsistencies that could lead to customer dissatisfaction or operational errors in order allocation.
business_requirements.business_value: Ensures a consistent and comprehensive browsing experience for customers, enabling them to identify and select items to fulfill their immediate needs (Q01, Q09).
business_requirements.requirement_basis: The IR states that catalog items must be aggregated from multiple store partners and that product categories must be consistent across all store partners (DOCUMENTED_FACT).
business_requirements.basis_explanation: Without standardization, the aggregation of disparate store catalogs would result in conflicting data, undermining the primary purpose of the unified interface.

origin.description: The unified digital representation of all sellable items, including descriptions, images, categories, and standardized pricing derived from the store partners' offerings.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of catalog items with standardized category hierarchy matching platform structure
Number of customer complaints regarding inconsistent product descriptions or pricing

policies_and_constraints: Product categories must be consistent with the platform structure (Q06).
Item descriptions must be accurate to prevent customer misunderstandings (Q05).
assumptions: Store Partners can provide raw data in a format compatible with the platform's normalization rules (Q10).
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Store Partners fail to update pricing or descriptions in a timely manner, leading to stale data (Q07).
Dependency: Reliance on the Platform Operator to ingest and normalize data from individual Store Partners (Q10).

business_requirements.name: BR-02: Enforce Pricing Integrity and Partner Agreement Compliance
business_requirements.business_requirement: The Platform Operator must validate that all displayed prices adhere to Store Partner agreements and do not exceed maximum allowed limits, ensuring financial compliance and preventing revenue leakage.
business_requirements.business_objective: To resolve conflicts between store and platform pricing and ensure a consistent customer experience while protecting partner margins.
business_requirements.business_value: Supports the Platform Operator in managing assortment strategy and prevents catalog inconsistencies that could lead to financial disputes (Q04, Q05).
business_requirements.requirement_basis: The IR states that pricing must be standardized or adjusted according to agreed terms and that pricing must not exceed the maximum allowed by partner agreements (DOCUMENTED_FACT).
business_requirements.basis_explanation: Pricing is a critical business decision supported by the system; failure to enforce partner terms violates the Store Partner Agreement and undermines trust.

origin.description: The unified digital representation of all sellable items, including descriptions, images, images, categories, and standardized pricing derived from the store partners' offerings.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of catalog items where displayed price is within partner-agreed maximum limits
Number of pricing conflicts resolved between store and platform pricing

policies_and_constraints: Pricing must not exceed the maximum allowed by partner agreements (Q06).
Pricing must be standardized or adjusted according to agreed terms (Q06).
assumptions: Partner agreements explicitly define maximum allowed pricing and adjustment rules (Q10).
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Unauthorized price changes by Store Partners could lead to customer dissatisfaction or legal disputes (Q05).
Dependency: Real-time access to Store Partner pricing rules and inventory snapshots (Q10).

business_requirements.name: BR-03: Ensure Product Information Accuracy and Completeness
business_requirements.business_requirement: The Platform Operator must ensure that product images correspond to the listed SKU descriptions and that all required fields (SKU, name, description) are present and accurate to prevent customer misunderstandings.
business_requirements.business_objective: To drive conversion by presenting accurate descriptions, images, and prices, reducing return rates and support costs.
business_requirements.business_value: Ensures a unified, consistent view of available goods across disparate store partners and drives conversion (Q01, Q09).
business_requirements.requirement_basis: The IR states that product images must correspond to the listed SKU descriptions and that item descriptions must be accurate to prevent customer misunderstandings (DOCUMENTED_FACT).
business_requirements.basis_explanation: Inaccurate product information directly impacts the customer's ability to identify and select items, undermining the business purpose of the catalog.

origin.description: The unified digital representation of all sellable items, including descriptions, images, categories, and standardized pricing derived from the store partners' offerings.

success_measures.measure: Rate of product returns due to description/image mismatch
Percentage of catalog items with complete and accurate required fields

policies_and_constraints: Product images must correspond to the listed SKU descriptions (Q06).
Item descriptions must be accurate to prevent customer misunderstandings (Q05).
assumptions: Merchandisers have the capability to curate and update product details effectively (Q10).
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Stale or incorrect data from Store Partners leads to customer returns (Q07).
Dependency: Reliance on Merchandiser curation and Store Partner data ingestion (Q10).

business_requirements.name: BR-04: Support Dynamic Assortment and Promotional Strategy
business_requirements.business_requirement: The Platform Operator must enable the selection of SKUs to display based on demand and profitability, and support active flags for discounts, bundles, or limited-time offers.
business_requirements.business_objective: To optimize revenue and market share by allowing flexible control over product visibility and pricing strategies.
business_requirements.business_value: Supports business decisions on selecting SKUs to display and setting dynamic pricing or promotional discounts (Q01, Q04).
business_requirements.requirement_basis: The IR states that business decisions are supported by selecting which SKUs to display based on demand and profitability, and setting dynamic pricing or promotional discounts (LOGICAL_DEDUCTION).
business_requirements.basis_explanation: The catalog is not just a passive list but a strategic tool for assortment management; the system must support the logic for these decisions.

origin.description: The unified digital representation of all sellable items, including descriptions, images, categories, and standardized pricing derived from the store partners' offerings.

success_measures.measure: Conversion rate of promoted items vs. non-promoted items

policies_and_constraints: Catalog data must reflect current promotions and shelf-life constraints (Q06).
Promotional Tags must be active flags for discounts, bundles, or limited-time offers (Q06).
assumptions: Analytics Team has access to demand and profitability data to inform SKU selection (Q10).
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Inability to update promotions in real-time could lead to missed sales opportunities (Q07).
Dependency: Integration with external demand forecasting or profitability models (Q10).

business_requirements.name: BR-05: Maintain Real-Time Inventory Visibility
business_requirements.business_requirement: The Platform Operator must integrate with Real-Time Inventory Snapshots to ensure that catalog items reflect current stock availability and shelf-life constraints.
business_requirements.business_objective: To prevent order allocation failures and customer dissatisfaction caused by selling out-of-stock or expired items.
business_requirements.business_value: Ensures the catalog reflects current promotions and shelf-life constraints, supporting Order Validation and Resource Allocation (Q01, Q05).
business_requirements.requirement_basis: The IR states that catalog data must reflect current promotions and shelf-life constraints and that expiring items must be marked with remaining shelf-life indicators (DOCUMENTED_FACT).
business_requirements.basis_explanation: A catalog without accurate inventory status is functionally useless for Order Initiation and Selection; it creates a false promise of availability.

origin.description: The unified digital representation of all sellable items, including descriptions, images, categories, and standardized pricing derived from the store partners' offerings.

success_measures.measure: Percentage of orders placed for items that are actually in stock
Frequency of catalog items marked as expired or out of stock

policies_and_constraints: Expiring items must be marked with remaining shelf-life indicators (Q06).
Catalog data must reflect current promotions and shelf-life constraints (Q06).
assumptions: Store Partners provide reliable real-time inventory data (Q10).
risks_and_dependencies: Risk: Inventory data latency leads to overselling or expired product sales (Q07).
Dependency: Real-time data feed from Store Partners and Real-Time Inventory Snapshot (Q10).
